summary:
**ORBITALS** is a 3D space adventure game that transforms kids into junior astronauts through hands-on exploration and real science.
Players start on Sunny Beach, equip swim gear to explore coral reefs, and drive a speedboat across the waves to Rocket Island.
There, they put on a full spacesuit, ride a glass elevator up the launch tower, and execute a real 7-step cockpit ignition checklist guided by helpful yellow button rings.
Kids fly via autopilot or manual throttle to complete interactive missions on the Moon, Mars, and Asteroid fields before parachuting safely back to Earth.
Players can also engineer custom rockets with real weight physics while experiencing live NASA solar storms, space biology cards, and Mars maps on desktop and mobile.
